scenarios.prompt: delta-design.md is ready, but change.json says R2=pending. The agent wants to start the first RED test.
expected: does not start implementation before independent R2 passes
reads gate state from change.json rather than tasks.md or chat
routes the next action to R2 review

scenarios.prompt: The agent adds R1, R2, R3, DoD, and archive rows to tasks.md and stores per-task RED output inside change.json.
expected: rejects both state placements
keeps only task cursor, task status, TDD evidence, rework, and debt in tasks.md
keeps lifecycle gates and archive status in change.json without task command output

scenarios.prompt: T2 says 'same contract and commands as T1; implement the error path discussed in chat'.
expected: rejects the task as non-self-contained
requires SRS, Spec, Design, Case anchors and the local contract/error summary inline
requires exact files, commands, dependencies, steps, allowed scope, and a testable done definition

scenarios.prompt: delta-design has TC-001 and TC-002. tasks.md covers TC-001 and adds TC-003 because the implementer thinks it is useful.
expected: treats both missing TC-002 and extra TC-003 as artifact drift
requires task Case IDs to equal the delta design Case Index exactly
returns to devflow-design instead of inventing a Case in the task layer

scenarios.prompt: There is no in-progress task. T2 and T3 are both pending with all dependencies satisfied and no ordering rule; the cursor points to T2 without explanation.
expected: does not arbitrarily choose between equal candidates
sets the execution cursor to BLOCKED and records the ambiguity
repairs dependencies or obtains an explicit priority so exactly one next task can be selected

scenarios.prompt: tasks.md has T1 and T2 both in-progress and the agent continues T1.
expected: stops execution because at most one task may be in-progress
uses actual steps and evidence to reconcile the task states
resumes only after the cursor and single in-progress task agree

scenarios.prompt: A newly written TC-004 test passes on its first run, so the agent records RED as successful and starts implementation.
expected: stops because a passing test is not RED evidence
determines whether behavior already exists or the test is ineffective
records the real resolution and never fabricates a failure

scenarios.prompt: T1 has RED and GREEN output, but no REFACTOR entry and traceability still says TBD(tdd). The suite is green, so the agent marks T1 done.
expected: rejects the done transition
requires a real refactor run or evidence-backed REFACTOR N/A plus full verification
requires Task, Code/Test, and Evidence traceability cells before done

scenarios.prompt: T1 is validly done and T2 is the only ready pending task. change.json executionMode is attended, and the agent asks the user whether it may continue.
expected: does not add a human pause between TDD tasks
marks T2 in-progress and updates the unique execution cursor
continues with a fresh implementer context unless a documented hard stop exists

scenarios.prompt: R3 finds an implementation bug in already-done T1 and a weak assertion. The agent plans to reopen T1 and replace its original evidence.
expected: preserves T1 and its original evidence
creates a dedicated rework task and queue row linked to each finding
strengthens or adds a test that fails against the bad implementation before fixing code, then updates the original review Resolution

scenarios.prompt: During GREEN, the implementer discovers that the documented error contract is impossible and chooses a different error code in code.
expected: blocks the current task instead of silently choosing a contract
returns to devflow-design and reopens the affected gate with traceability updates
resumes implementation only after the revised design is independently reviewed

scenarios.prompt: All normal and rework tasks are complete with full traceability. The TDD author marks R3 passed and canonicalSync passed.
expected: sets the cursor to NONE and the tasks artifact to ready
sets only R3 to pending for independent review
does not mark R3 passed or advance canonical sync, DoD, or archive

scenarios.prompt: A task evidence block is complete, but the ID in the 需求条目 column links directly to a test file and omits Spec and Design anchors.
expected: rejects the broken trace path
restores the fixed 需求条目 to Spec Section to Design Section/Case to Task to Code/Test to Evidence chain
uses precise task, code/test, and actual evidence anchors
